dial._backend: auto = encoder when RPi.GPIO is importable, otherwise the keyboard/wheel simulation. Force with 'encoder', 'keyboard', or 'null'.
dial._pins: BCM numbering. Pick pins not already claimed by gpio_pins in appsettings.json.
dial._invert: Set true if turning the knob clockwise moves the menu the wrong way -- cheaper than resoldering CLK and DT.
dial._keys: Keyboard-simulation only. The mouse wheel also works and is the closest match to a detented knob.
